_about: The 14 recordings with motor (PWM) timelines, their surface label and the evidence for it (one line each). Surface labels are analysis decisions, not data paths; the paths are in config.json. 'analysed': false = opened and listed, no drive analysis (no driving / no LiDAR extract).
